description: Original 512 independent paired nuclear orientations, copied without changing the archived matrices. This contains rotations only, not cached forward results.
precision: Archived float32 rotation values are retained exactly when promoted to float64. Both nuclei have independent draws; deformation cases share the same bank.
reuse: Recompute every orientation at the new precision and quadrature. Do not append old coarse-grid intensities into a refined-grid mean.
